title: SpCas9 protein + oriented spacers + frozen phage/plasmid target library
claim_scope: positive-control reconstruction; validates the paired-evidence link only

spacer_orientation.evidence: Independent recomputation on 2026-10-01 (orientation_probe in run_dual_evidence_case.py). With spacers exactly as provided, the conserved 3nt signal sits UPSTREAM: consensus CCA / 2.614 bits versus downstream GTT / 0.810 bits. Reverse-complementing the spacers moves the identical signal DOWNSTREAM: TGG / 2.614 bits versus AAC / 0.810 bits. Per-spacer check: as provided, 25 of 37 spacers carry the upstream CCx motif and 0 of 37 carry a downstream xGG; after reverse-complementing, 26 of 37 carry downstream xGG. The signal is therefore consistent and single-orientation, with no split-spacer ambiguity. Reverse is correct because Cas9 PAMs lie downstream of the protospacer. The upstream PAMpredict bundle does not declare a direction; predict_pam.py infers it at runtime via pam_on_wrong_strand, and the local pipeline records --reverse-spacers.
spacer_orientation.not_evidence: The per-hit target strand of a spacer match (17 forward / 20 reverse) is NOT evidence about array orientation. find_spacer_hits searches both target strands for every spacer and always reports flanks in the spacer's own frame, so a mix of hit strands is expected and carries no orientation information. Orientation is decided only by which side carries the conserved signal.
spacer_orientation.cross_check: All 8 spacers published for S. pyogenes 7F7 match the independent CCTyper re-annotation of CP007240.1 exactly, on the same strand (data/parsed/genome_agent_real_20260928).

spacers.redistribution: NoDerivatives: do not redistribute a modified or repackaged copy; re-fetch from upstream.

targets.source_name: PAMpredict example phage contigs (GPD/MGV-derived VirSorter/VirFinder records)
targets.redistribution: NoDerivatives: do not redistribute; re-fetch from upstream.
targets.ecological_note: 64 of 67 contigs are unnamed uvig_/ivig_ records from human gut virome catalogues (GPD/MGV). That is not the ecological niche of Streptococcus pyogenes, so this library is a technical reconstruction rather than an ecological target set.

limitations: The protein is an exact Protein2PAM training exposure; this is a positive control, not generalisation evidence.
The gold PAM is the canonical SpCas9 NGG, not an assay performed on this exact construct.
Target contigs are not clustered to the virus level; support_target_count therefore overstates independent evidence.
Spacer evidence is evolutionary (spacer-protospacer homology), not cleavage activity.
PAMpredict is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0, so its inputs must be re-fetched by the user rather than bundled.
